title: Battery Discovery Configuration
description: Configuration for automated battery product discovery system

enabled.description: Master switch for discovery system. Set to false to disable all discovery runs.

maxCandidatesPerRun.description: Maximum number of new candidates to create per discovery run. Prevents overwhelming user with too many products to review.

manufacturersPerRun.description: Number of manufacturers to check per run. Set to 1 to rotate through manufacturers on each run.

maxPagesPerManufacturer.description: Maximum product listing pages to crawl per manufacturer. Prevents excessive crawling on large catalogs.

minPrice.description: Minimum price filter (USD). Null = no minimum. Candidates below this price will be skipped.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price filter (USD). Null = no maximum. Candidates above this price will be skipped.

requiredKeywords.description: Global keywords required on ALL products (case-insensitive). Usually empty - let manufacturers define their own. Checked against entire page content.

excludeKeywords.description: Global exclude keywords applied to ALL manufacturers (case-insensitive). Usually empty - let manufacturers define their own. Checked against product title and description only.

crawlDelayMs.description: Delay between HTTP requests in milliseconds. Minimum 1000ms (1 second) for polite crawling. 2000ms recommended.

userAgent.description: User-Agent string sent with HTTP requests. Should identify your crawler and provide contact info.
